notes.title: New update: lights & control setting
notes.notes:
Hello again,

We've got another good announcement for you :)
[h1]This time we updated the lights and the control settings.[/h1]

[b]We decided to change the lights [/b]in some of the locations from dynamic to static.
We hope that this will prove to be a better solution and you will enjoy the game more. 

[b]We also fixed a problem with the control settings [/b].
You should now be able to change the controls freely!

Hope you like the update? :)
Inner Voices Team

notes.title: New content update for Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have some good news for you! :)

[b]A new content update and patch will be available on Steam Summer Sale![/b]

[h1]We addressed most of the issues and fixed most of the bugs reported by the players, related to:[/h1][list]
[*][b]stability,[/b] 
[*][b]visuals,[/b]
[*][b]game mechanics.[/b][/list]

[h1]We have also added new features for you to enjoy.[/h1]

From now on you will be able to:
 
[b]- Adjust “jumpscares” in the Options Menu.[/b]
You can now turn the jump scares off in the Options Menu at any time during the game. 
Also, all of the available jumpscares occur just once in the gameplay.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/e4b6ed23b359072dda0516428c35cc7b4e28b505.jpg[/img]
 
[b]- Enjoy new riddles.[/b]
We added new environmental riddles. 
You can explore your surroundings and solve them to complete The Alphabet. 
The tasks are not related to the main story. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/5ea3145134d695380279e61110f36de7bd914ac4.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/b2917777406fdf097bca0587216604597fbb01b2.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/a426c48aac87169d79ce55effb225802bf738fc2.jpg[/img]

Thanks to your feedback we can keep improving our game!
Thank you and stay tuned!

Inner Voices team.
